diagnosticObservations: One subsequent instrumented 101-call protected diagnostic retained all samples locally and did not change GC configuration or force collection. Many slow calls spent 13-19 ms in protected open; four observed GC callbacks were about 0.2-1.8 ms and did not explain most slow calls. Phase times overlap and are not qualification.

An independent single 25-open synthetic fixture diagnostic measured median open 4.687 ms, configuration 3.098 ms (journal_mode read 3.004 ms), schema verification 0.809 ms, path checks 0.331 ms, held open 0.395 ms and Win32 guards 0.071 ms. The lighter fixture did not reproduce gateway tails. Duplicate header setter and reusable Win32 binding savings were too small to justify another safety-sensitive change as a tail remedy.
All adverse samples remain retained. No protection setting, target, GC behavior, connection lifetime, or benchmark sample inclusion was weakened; no performance baseline was established.
